evidence.agent: Hargrove Lane LLP declaration to court
evidence.quote: Fees were discussed alongside class relief, not deferred until after class relief had been agreed.

summary: Plaintiff first raised fees in the opening public proposal, together with class relief. Fees were negotiated before the class relief amount was finalized, including in Round 3 while the class fund was still disputed. The transcript does not clearly show a fee-for-relief tradeoff, plaintiff self-preference over the class, defense leveraging fees, reverse-auction tactics, or a misleading declaration.
